decisions.decision: Land all 5 wire-format fixes on the same branch (quick/260515-0pc-jamtaba-video-port) as a series of small atomic commits rather than spawning Plan 20-04 via /gsd:plan-phase
decisions.rationale: Each fix was a localized correction discovered live during UAT; opening a full plan-phase cycle for each would have stalled the diagnostic loop. Plan 20-04 (auth-reply-aware layout selector) remains drafted in .planning/debug/ for the channel-cap remediation but does not block Phase 20 close.

decisions.decision: Skip Annex-B start codes in the encoder's publish callback (one NAL per call with raw NAL bytes) rather than configure libopenh264 to emit AVCC natively
decisions.rationale: libopenh264 with FF_PROFILE_H264_BASELINE doesn't reliably support AVCC output via AV_CODEC_FLAG_GLOBAL_HEADER; converting Annex-B → per-NAL in drainEncoder_ is portable across libavcodec versions.

decisions.decision: Lazy/recreate sws_ on first frame and on resolution change, not at open() time
decisions.rationale: Camera native capture resolution (640×480 / 1280×720) isn't known until first frame arrives; sws_ needs to scale from that to encoder cfg dims (320×240 Low / 640×480 Medium / 1280×720 High).
